concerns.text: FR-001 and SC-005 require Band Gap and Formation Energy from OQMD and Thermal Conductivity from AFLOW, but T002 fetches matbench_expt_gap, matbench_mp_e_form, and boltztrap_mp — all matminer/Materials-Project-derived sources, none from OQMD or AFLOW. The task silently substitutes data sources for two of three datasets without a spec amendment. Either amend FR-001/SC-005 to name the matminer sources or change the fetch.

T002 mandates 'FAIL LOUDLY: on any fetch error, raise — never fall back' and 'a failed fetch must abort the run', but spec §6 explicitly assumes 'fallback to pre-processed CSVs if API fails' and NFR-002 requires graceful handling of API failures. The task retroactively narrows a documented spec behavior with no amendment; the spec's fallback assumption must be amended or the task must implement the documented fallback.

plan.md specifies downloading via the HuggingFace `datasets` library; T002 implements `matminer.datasets.load_dataset` with no recorded justification. The task contradicts the plan's declared mechanism — either update the plan or justify the divergence in the task.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T003–T011 vs plan.md:Project Structure / data-model.md:Data Flow
concerns.text: All tasks write outputs to `data/results/` while plan.md and data-model.md place them under `results/` (e.g. `results/metrics_raw.csv`, `results/uq_methods.csv`). The path divergence means T011's handoff will reference artifacts in locations the plan/data-model do not agree on. Pick one convention and align plan, data-model, and tasks.
